## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. [Method](../method.md)

<pre>
source                         results  share of the score
<a name="first-party-qwen-scores"></a><a href="https://arxiv.org/pdf/2511.21631v2#page=16">Qwen (lab)</a>                          25  100% ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇
prior: pull toward the middle             0% ▇
weighted average                        = 57.8
</pre>

## How to run it

api (Alibaba Cloud Model Studio) · $0.35/M blended · $0.2 in / $0.8 out per 1M tokens · [alibabacloud.com](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/model-pricing)

<sub>[price source](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/model-pricing): USD per 1M tokens, Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, Singapore (International deployment scope), API model qwen3-vl-30b-a3b-instruct (Non-Thinking mode only): input $0.2, output $0.8. Chinese-mainland/Global (US) deployments priced differently and not used, following the International convention of other Alibaba rows; free quota, batch and context-cache discounts excluded. Observed 2026-10-09. · [context source](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct/blob/9c4b90e1e4ba969fd3b5378b57d966d725f1b86c/README.md): Official Qwen model card: 'Native 256K context, expandable to 1M'. Observed 2026-10-09.</sub>

### Run it on your own machine

**llama.cpp** · install: macOS / Linux `curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh` · Windows `irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex` · [other ways](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md) · Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead.

```sh
# 4-bit Q4_K_M · ~18.6GB
llama cli -hf Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-GGUF:Q4_K_M
# or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
llama serve -hf Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-GGUF:Q4_K_M
# 8-bit Q8_0 · ~32.5GB
llama cli -hf Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-GGUF:Q8_0
# or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
llama serve -hf Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-GGUF:Q8_0
```

**LM Studio** · install: [macOS / Windows / Linux](https://lmstudio.ai/download) · Open the app once before using the lms command.

```sh
# 4-bit Q4_K_M · ~18.6GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-GGUF@Q4_K_M -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
# 8-bit Q8_0 · ~32.5GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-GGUF@Q8_0 -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
# 4-bit mlx-4bit · mac only · ~18.3GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-MLX-4bit -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
# 4-bit mlx-8bit · mac only · ~33.5GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-MLX-8bit -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
```

**Ollama** · install: [macOS / Windows](https://ollama.com/download) · Linux `curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh`

```sh
# 4-bit q4_k_m · ~20GB
ollama run qwen3-vl:30b-a3b-instruct
# 8-bit q8_0 · ~34GB
ollama run qwen3-vl:30b-a3b-instruct-q8_0
# 4-bit Q4_K_M · ~18.6GB
ollama run hf.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-GGUF:Q4_K_M
# 8-bit Q8_0 · ~32.5GB
ollama run hf.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-GGUF:Q8_0
```

**MLX (Mac)** · install: with uv `uv tool install mlx-lm` · or `pip install mlx-lm` · Apple silicon Macs only, text only.

```sh
# 4-bit mlx-4bit · mac only · ~18.3GB
mlx_lm.chat --model lmstudio-community/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-MLX-4bit
# or start an OpenAI-compatible server at http://localhost:8080/v1
mlx_lm.server --model lmstudio-community/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-MLX-4bit
# 4-bit mlx-8bit · mac only · ~33.5GB
mlx_lm.chat --model lmstudio-community/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-MLX-8bit
# or start an OpenAI-compatible server at http://localhost:8080/v1
mlx_lm.server --model lmstudio-community/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-MLX-8bit
```
